jobs.title: Customer Care Coordinator - Delivery Sched. I
jobs.description:
At Numotion, we’re on a mission to improve the lives of people with disabilities. As North America’s largest provider of mobility products and services, we deliver personalized solutions from manual and power wheelchairs to medical supplies and other assistive technologies that support health, independence, and everyday participation. We’re committed to a workforce of diverse backgrounds and experiences and to an inclusive environment shaped by open dialogue, attentive listening, and tangible, ongoing action.

**Pay Range: $20.77/HR to $27.00/HR.** **It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location.**

**JOB PURPOSE****:**

Schedules deliveries and coordinates the timely provision of services for Rehab and Aftersale order types.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assists customers, referral sources and Numotion team members with Rehab and Aftersale delivery scheduling, enters and maintains accurate data in all applicable order tracking systems.

* Communicates with clients and referral sources to find the optimal or recommended scheduling availability for their appointment.

* Enters updates into all applicable order tracking systems, ensuring all efforts are made to optimize ATP and seating technician schedules.

* Responds to customer and referral source inquiries and requests in a timely manner working with other staff members to increase customer satisfaction and turnaround times.

* Takes responsibility to completely resolve issues without additional transfers and/or de-escalate customers whenever possible.

* Meets all set productivity and performance standards.

* Participates in Rehab initiatives to continuously improve department results.

* Other duties as assigned.

* Utilize Numotion Leadership Principles to perform job with integrity, compliance, and values consistent with Numotion’s mission.

* Adhere to employee or customer confidentiality and comply with Numotion’s policies and federal regulations.

* Provide excellent customer service for all internal and external customers of the operations at all times. Provide solutions for customer concerns and continually focus on customer service as our top priority.

* The above duties and responsibilities are not an all-inclusive list but rather a general representation of the duties and responsibilities associated with this position. The duties and responsibilities will be subject to change based on organizational needs and/or as deemed necessary by management.

**REQUIRED** **QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS****,** **AND EXPERIENCE****:**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) or equivalent combination of experience and education.

* Minimum one year of customer service experience or dispatching/routing experience.

**PREFERRED COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

* Strong listening, organization and priority setting skills.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple priorities.

* Ability to think quickly, assess a situation and make a sound decision.

* Ability to provide best-in-class customer service

* Knowledge of complex rehab equipment and products

* Prior experience working in durable medical equipment industry

* Demonstration of exceptional interpersonal and problem-solving skills both internally and externally with customers.

* Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

**PHYSICAL WORK REQUIREMENTS:**

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Ability to meet essential functions of the position with reasonable accommodations as necessary.

* Frequent use of hands, wrists, fingers associated with computer equipment.

* Prolonged periods of time working at a desk and/or on a computer.

* Occasionally move and reach with arms and hands.

* Ability to communicate effectively.

* Ability to work overtime as needed.

  

At Numotion, we offer competitive compensation packages, including medical, dental and vision insurance, short-term and long-term disability, a 401k, and life insurance. Numotion is an equal opportunity employer. We strive for a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and do not tolerate discrimination against our employees, customers, and partners regardless of ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, citizenship, marital or veteran status. Numotion is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

jobs.title: Community Health Worker - Los Angeles area
jobs.description:
**Reliance Hospice and Palliative Care** is actively seeking an experienced **Community Health Worker (Medical Assistant)** to support patients and families throughout the **Los Angeles area**.

This is a **field-based position** for a highly experienced, professional, and compassionate individual who is comfortable spending most of the day traveling between **patient homes, healthcare facilities, and referral sources** and meeting directly with patients and families.

**Hourly compensation starts at $25/hour and up, depending on experience.**

The ideal candidate will have a strong healthcare background, excellent **customer service and interpersonal skills**, and experience communicating with patients, families, healthcare professionals, and referral partners. Hospice or palliative care experience, as well as healthcare outreach or sales experience, is required.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

The Community Health Worker is responsible for providing patients and families with clear explanations and education regarding hospice and palliative care benefits, helping ensure timely access to services, and increasing community awareness of Reliance Hospice & Palliative Care.

The CHW will also assist with communication between the agency and referral sources and develop relationships within the healthcare and local community.

Responsibilities include:

* Meet with patients and families in **homes, healthcare facilities, and other community settings**.
* Explain hospice and palliative care services and benefits in a clear, compassionate, and professional manner.
* Provide excellent customer service and serve as a positive representative of Reliance Hospice & Palliative Care.
* Build and maintain relationships with referral sources, healthcare professionals, community organizations, and families.
* Conduct community outreach and education for healthcare professionals, civic leaders, and members of the public.
* Assist with communication between patients, families, referral sources, and the agency.
* Travel throughout the assigned Los Angeles service area as needed.
* Demonstrate compassion and professionalism when working with patients and families facing life-limiting illness, death, or bereavement.
* Independently coordinate activities while maintaining strong organization and follow-through.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS

* High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent work experience.
* **At least 2 years of hospice and/or palliative care experience required.**
* Previous **healthcare sales, business development, community outreach, or referral development experience required**.
* Strong **customer service and interpersonal skills**.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, public relations, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate tactfully and compassionately with patients, families, referral sources, and community partners.
* Professional, confident, and comfortable **working in the field and meeting with patients and families throughout the day**.
* Ability to work independently, organize activities, and manage multiple priorities.
* Bilingual in **Spanish is preferred**.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to drive to patient homes, facilities, and referral locations.
* Ability to meet the physical requirements of the position.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Experience:

* Customer service: 3 years (Required)
* Hospice & palliative medicine: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Care Manager RN - Medical Management
jobs.description:
**Description**

Care Management is a collaborative practice model including the patients, nurses, social workers, physicians, other practitioners, caregivers and the community. The care management process encompasses excellent communication, both verbal and written, and facilitates care along a continuum through effective resource coordination.

Providence caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Providence Medical Foundation and thrive in our culture of patient-focused, whole-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
* Upon hire: California Registered Nurse License
* 3 years Clinical experience in an HMO, medical group, affiliated model, hospital or medical office/clinic setting.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or,
* Master's Degree in Related field.
* Upon hire: Certification in Case Management (CCM, ACM)
* Upon hire: Specialty Certification in Oncology, Rehab, Pediatrics, Transplant, or Wound Care
* Proficiency in Milliman Care Guidelines, preferred.
* 3 years Experience in utilization management or case management.

**Why Join Providence?**

Our best-in-class benefits are uniquely designed to support you and your family in staying well, growing professionally, and achieving financial security. We take care of you, so you can focus on delivering our Mission of caring for everyone, especially the most vulnerable in our communities.

**About Providence**

At Providence, our strength lies in Our Promise of “Know me, care for me, ease my way.” Working at our family of organizations means that regardless of your role, we’ll walk alongside you in your career, supporting you so you can support others. We provide best-in-class benefits and we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone is essential, heard and respected. Together, our 120,000 caregivers (all employees) serve in over 50 hospitals, over 1,000 clinics and a full range of health and social services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington. As a comprehensive health care organization, we are serving more people, advancing best practices and continuing our more than 100-year tradition of serving the poor and vulnerable.

Posted are the minimum and the maximum wage rates on the wage range for this position. The successful candidate's placement on the wage range for this position will be determined based upon relevant job experience and other applicable factors. These amounts are the base pay range; additional compensation may be available for this role, such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonus opportunities.

Providence offers a comprehensive benefits package including a retirement 401(k) Savings Plan with employer matching, health care benefits (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, disability insurance, time off benefits (paid parental leave, vacations, holidays, health issues), voluntary benefits, well-being resources and much more. Learn more at providence.jobs/benefits.

Applicants in the Unincorporated County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Unincorporated Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

**About the Team**

Providence Clinical Network (PCN) is a service line within Providence serving patients across seven states with quality, compassionate, coordinated care. Collectively, our medical groups and affiliate practices are the third largest group in the country with over 11,000 providers, 900 clinics and 30,000 caregivers.

PCN is comprised of Providence Medical Group in Alaska, Washington, Montana and Oregon; Swedish Medical Group in Washington’s greater Puget Sound area, Pacific Medical Centers in western Washington; Kadlec in southeast Washington; Providence’s St. John’s Medical Foundation in Southern California; Providence Medical Institute in Southern California; Providence Facey Medical Foundation in Southern California; Providence Medical Foundation in Northern and Southern California; and Covenant Medical Group and Covenant Health Partners in west Texas and eastern New Mexico.

Providence is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the principle that every workforce member has the right to work in surroundings that are free from all forms of unlawful discrimination and harassment on the basis of race, color, gender, disability, veteran, military status, religion, age, creed, national origin, sexual identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by local, state, or federal law. We believe diversity makes us stronger, so we are dedicated to shaping an inclusive workforce, learning from each other, and creating equal opportunities for advancement.

**Company:** Providence Jobs
  
**Job Category:** Care Management
  
**Job Function:** Clinical Care
  
**Job Schedule:** Full time
  
**Job Shift:** Day
  
**Career Track:** Nursing
  
**Department:** 7520 HCS MEDICAL MGMT CA HERITAGE
  
**Address:** CA Anaheim 200 W Center St Promenade
  
**Work Location:** St Joseph Home Health-Anaheim
  
**Workplace Type:** Hybrid
  
**Pay Range:** $57.28 - $88.92
  
The amounts listed are the base pay range; additional compensation may be available for this role, such as shift differentials, standby/on-call, overtime, premiums, extra shift incentives, or bonus opportunities.

jobs.title: CalFresh Community Works Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** CalFresh Community Works Program Coordinator

**STATUS:** Full-time, Non-Exempt

**DEPARTMENT:** CalFresh Community Works Program (CCWP)

**BENEFITS:** Yes

**REPORTS TO:** CCWP Program Manager

**LOCATION:** San Francisco

**SUPERVISES:** N/A

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The CalFresh Community Works Program (CCWP) Coordinator is responsible for coordinating day-to-day participant activities and supporting routine operations of Project Open Hand's CalFresh Community Works Program. The Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for participants throughout their program experience and works collaboratively with Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, community partners, and internal staff to support successful participant engagement, skill development, and program completion.

The Coordinator provides day-to-day participant guidance and support, onboarding support, placement coordination, progress monitoring, documentation management, and compliance support. This position plays a critical role in supporting participant engagement, achievement of program objectives, adherence to program requirements, and successful completion of CCWP activities while maintaining accurate records and supporting reporting and reimbursement processes in accordance with established program policies and procedures.

**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:**

* Minimum three (3) years of experience providing similar services, including coordinating multi-site or partner-based community service, workforce development, volunteer, or participant-based programs.
* Demonstrated experience in participant services, volunteer coordination, workforce development, social services, customer service, community engagement, or a related field.
* Experience maintaining databases, tracking participant information, and maintaining accurate records.
* Experience maintaining documentation and supporting reporting activities within databases and program management systems.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds, experiences, needs, and abilities.
* Strong customer service skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain confidentiality.

**QUALIFICATIONS DESIRED:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Workforce Development, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience considered.
* Experience working with workforce development, CalFresh, volunteer engagement, public benefits, or community-based programs.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and/or similar client, volunteer, or program management databases.
* Experience supporting grant-funded programs and program performance tracking.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
* Bilingual proficiency in Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, or Tagalog preferred.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Participant Operations & Coordination**

* Coordinate day-to-day participant activities and support routine CCWP program operations.
* Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, and support to CCWP participants, including assignment monitoring, workplace conduct guidance, attendance review, and issue resolution in accordance with established program procedures.
* Monitor participant attendance, participation, and engagement; identify concerns and communicate recommendations to the CCWP Program Manager in accordance with program policies.
* Build positive working relationships with participants to support successful engagement, retention, and program completion.
* Communicate program expectations, requirements, schedules, and updates to participants.
* Provide supportive coaching and guidance to help participants develop workplace skills, address barriers to participation, and achieve individual program goals.
* Serve as a resource to participants and facilitate referrals to internal and external support services when appropriate.

**Enrollment, Orientation & Training**

* Coordinate participant onboarding, orientation, enrollment support activities, and readiness preparation.
* Facilitate participant orientations, trainings, informational sessions, and program briefings.
* Ensure required participant documentation is collected, maintained, and appropriately recorded within designated systems.
* Support participants in understanding program requirements, workplace expectations, safety practices, and agency policies.
* Coordinate with internal departments and community partners to support participant readiness and successful placement.

**Placement Coordination & Host Site Support**

* Coordinate participant referrals and placements with Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, and community partners.
* Serve as a liaison among participants, Volunteer Services, Host Site Departments, and community partners.
* Coordinate participant schedules and support successful placements.
* Monitor participant placements and assist in resolving placement, scheduling, attendance, and engagement concerns.
* Maintain collaborative working relationships with internal departments and community partners to support program operations and participant success.

**Progress Monitoring & Documentation**

* Monitor and document participant progress toward established service and outcome objectives.
* Maintain accurate participant case notes, attendance records, participation history, and outcome documentation.
* Track participant engagement milestones, service activities, and program outcomes.
* Review participant attendance, service activity, and outcome data to support program performance monitoring and continuous improvement efforts.
* Enter, maintain, and reconcile participant records in Salesforce, Launchpad, and other required systems.
